caption: The drawing depicts a stylized floral scene centered between two decorated columns. The central object is a flowering plant with a black stem and branches, dark blue-green leaves, and several blossoms. The large, circular flowers at the top feature radial red and blue-green petals surrounding blue centers. Additional smaller, downward-facing, red flowers appear lower on the branches. The background is a buff or pale grayish-tan color. The scene is framed by two ornate columns, each with red and black twisted detailing and ledges resembling stone. Stylized arch motifs extend above the plant, connecting the columns. A patterned border, comprised of interlacing red, cream, and black elements with small black leaf-like accents, runs along the top and bottom edges of the drawing. The image utilizes a restrained palette of muted reds, blue-greens, blacks, and neutrals.
title: Fragment of Wall Decoration
